svg.title: Spatial generalization at epoch 6000
svg.desc: Two panels show ACT and TC-ACT success rates over XY half-ranges from ±2 to ±6 cm. ACT leads in Pick&Place; TC-ACT leads in Handover. Pick&Place AMP off; Handover AMP on. training seed 0 and five evaluation seeds, 1,250 rollouts per point.

g.text: Visual ACT / TC-ACT · E6000 · task-specific settings
Each point: 5 evaluation seeds × 250 paired rollouts = 1,250 per model/task/range.
Training seed 0. Wider ranges change the evaluation distribution; no confidence intervals inferred.
